title: AssemblyJob
description: Persistent record of a single document-assembly job. Every field except output_document_id and finished_at must be set when the job is created or immediately after the relevant step. (scope plan §4.2 AssemblyJob, G-09, AD-12, AD-13)

workspace_id.description: Immutable workspace identifier. Required on every workspace-owned record (AD-13).

request_id.description: Reference to the originating AssemblyRequest. Unique per workspace (G-09).

recipe_version.description: Recipe version pinned at job start. Immutable after resolving.

master_revision_id.description: Drive revision ID of the master template at copy time. Immutable after copy (AD-11).

resolved_blocks.description: Final ordered list of block IDs to retain. Fixed before any document mutation (scope plan §4.4 invariant 2).

output_document_id.description: Drive file ID of the assembled output document, or null before the copy step completes.

status.description: Current lifecycle state. See scope plan §4.3 AssemblyJob transitions.

code.description: Structured error code matching the exception classes in architecture §4.4.

step.description: The JobStep in which the error occurred.

message.description: Human-readable error description. Must not contain PII or document content (SB-06).

retryable.description: true if retrying with the same inputs may succeed (e.g. transient API error).

error.description: Structured error detail when status is 'failed', otherwise null.

run_by.description: Member ID or identity of the person who invoked the skill (R-05).

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job transitioned from 'requested' to 'validating'.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job reached a terminal state, or null if still active.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this ledger record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last ledger write to this record.
